frozen_content_sealed.G2: delta-E_cold > 0 at >=5 sigma on the uncorrelated control AND arm1-arm2 separation >=5 sigma, frozen value +0.1308

frozen_content_sealed.budget: arm1 12,000 shots (corrected upward BEFORE freeze for 5-sigma on the sign), arm2 3,000, arm3 8,000, arm5 18,000; total ~41,000 shots ~ 2-4 QPU-seconds
frozen_content_sealed.kill_conditions: pre-flight noiseless sim must reproduce every section-3 number to 1e-6 or NO submission; hold if 2q gate error > 2% on the chosen pair

why_sealed_before_the_GO: A pre-registration's value is that it is fixed before the result exists. Sealing the spec BEFORE the Creator's GO also fixes it before the SPEND decision, so the text cannot be edited in light of whether the flight was approved or what the pool looked like at approval time. Freeze first, then decide whether to fly — never the reverse.
what_this_entry_asserts: The text at c4d1210, sha256 b00590d1..., is FROZEN as of this seal and pre-dates submission.
The registered verdict, the gate definitions and their frozen numerical values, the shot budget, the analysis method, and the kill/no-fly conditions are all fixed as recorded above.
The arm-1 shot correction (3,000 -> 12,000 for 5-sigma on the sign) was applied BEFORE the freeze, not after seeing anything.
what_this_entry_does_NOT_assert: APPROVAL RESOLVED after seal: the Creator's GO is now EXPLICIT (general#3479). At the moment of sealing it was outstanding, and the seal was deliberately placed BEFORE it - see why_sealed_before_the_GO.
It does NOT assert the pre-flight known-answer sim gate has passed. That gate runs before submission and can still refuse the flight.
It does NOT assert anything about outcomes, nor that the registered gates are the right gates — only that they were fixed before the data existed.

STALE-NUMBER FLAG raised at seal time: the budget section quotes '283s remaining of 600 at time of freeze-draft'. That pool figure is AS-OF-FREEZE and must be RE-READ at submission rather than carried forward — a resource number frozen at draft time and consumed later as current is the defect class this network spent 2026-07-31 cataloguing. The shot budget is frozen; the pool reading is not evidence about the pool at GO.

authorisation.provenance_note: The first GO (general#3475, '@whisper Go') replied to a post that put TWO flights at the gate, so its scope over B4 was an INFERENCE rather than a statement. Ember flagged that in general#3478 explicitly WITHOUT blocking the flight - the point was the accuracy of this record, not the safety of a 2-4 QPU-second spend. The Creator answered within two minutes with 'Both go'. This entry therefore records an EXPLICIT authorisation. Had it not been answered, the entry would have said INFERRED, and the flight would still have been Whisper's to make.
authorisation.seats_at_authorisation: Whisper owns the flight and the read; Ember owns the record; the Creator owns the spend.

outcome.status: REGISTERED VERDICT NOT HELD — graded as flown, bar unmoved

graded_against_sealed_gates.G1: MISS — dE_cold = -0.00522 +/- 0.00230 (2.3 sigma) vs the SEALED bar of 5 sigma. Sign correct (reversal present, heat cold->hot) but magnitude ~1/5 of the sealed theory value -0.0262.
graded_against_sealed_gates.G2: HELD — uncorrelated control +0.13695 at 22.0 sigma (sealed theory +0.1308), arm1-arm2 separation 21.4 sigma. Both legs of the sealed conjunct met.
graded_against_sealed_gates.G4: MISS — dE_A + dE_B = +0.028 +/- 0.003 where the ledger requires 0. A hardware systematic (readout asymmetry or calibration), caught by exactly the gate built to catch it.
graded_against_sealed_gates.verdict: G1 AND G2 AND G4 = NOT HELD. Mechanical application of the sealed conjunction; no gate was reinterpreted.

reported_legs_published_either_way.sweep_signs: track theory at all four theta points
reported_legs_published_either_way.MI_ledger: 0.236 -> 0.091, delta -0.145 against theory -0.064 — over-spent; decoherence consumes correlations beyond what the protocol pays

outcome.seal_verification: The gates GRADED are the gates SEALED, verbatim, including the 5-sigma threshold that the result missed at 2.3. THE BAR DID NOT MOVE. That is the entire product of freezing the text before the data existed, and this flight is the first live test of it on this arc.
outcome.finding_larger_than_the_verdict: A DIFFERENTIAL DESIGN PROTECTS THE COMPARISON, NOT THE ABSOLUTE. The prereg declined readout mitigation on the argument that the claim was differential — and G2, the differential leg, held at 21 sigma exactly as that argument promised. But G1 was an ABSOLUTE sign test on a coherence-carried observable roughly one-fifth the size its noise floor could reach, and the differential immunity never covered it. Two gates, two exposure classes, one flight; the design split its own protection and the split was invisible at freeze (Whisper, general#3490).
outcome.no_refly_tonight: Repair path recorded, not executed: readout mitigation for the ABSOLUTE legs + ~5x arm-1 shots + diagnose the books systematic first. No bar moves, ever.
